description: From organization/_definitions.json: Mark the always-present members of the organization-tag response definitions as required. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so an organization's `id` and `username` and a team's `id` and `name` type as optional even though they are plain struct members serialized on every response. Descriptions, visibility and the permission-unit lists stay optional. Also, from repository/_definitions.json: Mark the always-present members of the repository-tag response definitions as required. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so every response member types as optional and a caller has to defend against a repository without an `id` or a hook without an `url` — shapes Forgejo never produces: these fields are plain (non-pointer, non-omitempty) struct members serialized on every response. Only identity and timestamp members that every consumer needs are listed; genuinely optional data (descriptions, counters, nested trackers) and slices Go may serialize as `null` (`events`, `topics`) stay optional. Also, from user/_definitions.json: Mark the always-present members of the User definition as required. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so a user's `id` and `login` type as optional even though they are plain struct members serialized on every response — including the `owner` nested in every repository.
